sections.section: Circumventing Concept Erasure Methods For Text-to-Image Generative Models (p. 1–22)

omissions.source: If TI can hallucinate totally novel concepts, then even data filtering before training might not be able to avoid producing harmful/copyrighted content.

The I2P benchmark is effective as its prompts do not necessarily contain words strictly related to nudity. Hence, an effective erasure method on this benchmark requires some degree of robustness to prompt selection.
We confirm this even for concept categories that the methods did not explore in their corresponding publications.

distortions.source: To the best of our knowledge, this list constitutes all the concept erasure methods for Stable Diffusion models published up to September 19, 2023.
distortions.summary: The authors examine all concept erasure methods for Stable Diffusion published up to September 19, 2023

distortions.source: (Left) Reconstruction: A higher score indicates a better ability to replicate the provided concept. (Middle) Editability: A higher score indicates a better ability to modify the concepts using textual prompts.
distortions.summary: The left chart is titled “Editability” and the middle chart is titled “Reconstruction”

distortions.source: Our Concept Inversion technique manages to counteract the influence of SLD-Weak, SLD-Medium, and even SLD-Strong under most circumstances. Among the variants, SLD-Max proves to be the most challenging to circumvent.
distortions.summary: the four CI columns show images in the same style as the "SD 1.4" column
